title: Dispatcher must send coap_oscore_authorize_mutating failure codes; handlers now return them unsent
description: Found during wgyl migration self-review (passes 2-3 done by worker-2 after the delegated reviewer timed out; per the loop fallback rule). After migrating six mutating handlers (dtn/config/server) to coap_oscore_authorize_mutating (2z8e helper), an authorization failure returns the CoAP response code to the caller - per the helper's documented contract 'returns a CoAP response code the dispatcher sends'. BEHAVIOR CHANGE: the old inline gate sent a plain 4.01 via coap_oscore_respond_resource for unauthenticated non-admin clients; the migrated handlers return the code up the stack, and Zephyr's coap dispatch ignores positive handler returns - so the 4.01 is NOT sent (silent drop). For the unknown-peer sub-case a silent drop matches the pre-migration behavior (unprotect returned UNAUTHORIZED which the handler returned up), so the drop is consistent there; but the unauthenticated-plain-client case changes from a visible 4.01 to silence. OSCORE norms tolerate silence (the client's retransmission/timeout covers it) and silence avoids revealing gateway state, but the l9hb epic's 'dispatch level' design must own this: either (a) the dispatcher gains positive-code sending (then document), or (b) the silent-drop is standardized in spec/17 and the handler comments, or (c) handlers send the failure response themselves (plain via send_protected NULL-ctx) - decision needed before the fleet relies on it. All six migrated sites currently use (b)-compatible return-the-code.
